scope: All current benchmark candidates and general process templates; source-specific preparations are separate from screening assumptions.
limitations: DOI registration confirms bibliographic identity, not experimental reproducibility or cost accuracy.
Missing, variable and qualitative conditions remain unresolved. Primary methods are curated only for the explicitly listed profiles.
Library imports are editable records. No literature protocol supplies measured plant utilities, industrial scale-up or complete cost validation.

review_methods.discovery: Thirty reaction-family Europe PMC searches and individual candidate DOI checks were followed by 70 candidate-specific open-access searches for entries lacking preparation records. Eighteen selected primary full texts were retrieved and screened. Search hits are not automatically accepted; composition, specimen and preparation boundaries are checked against Methods.
review_methods.selection: Read accessible primary Methods or supporting experimental sections for named specimens. Record numeric conditions only when explicit; separate synthesis from characterization, activation, performance tests and electrode fabrication.
review_methods.limitations: This is a catalog-wide evidence audit, not a systematic review of every published synthesis. Failure to retrieve a public text is not proof that no method exists.
